dialogues.speaker: Moce
dialogues.text: That's right! My uncle was in Sumeru before, but he came back in the last couple of days.

dialogues.speaker: Moce
dialogues.text: Dad says that Uncle didn't get anything done other than get himself into a bunch of debt before returning, but I bet that's a lie.

dialogues.speaker: Moce
dialogues.text: He just said that because he doesn't want me to leave town!
